dataSlots.scope: explicit source binding, compatible options and design goals; no arbitrary icons/history or on-device menu yet

localFonts.licensing: user-supplied bytes and nonempty authorization; not a legal license verification

icons.mask: explicit uploaded alpha-to-glyph conversion; not automatic color image recolor
icons.sourceSwitch: ProjectControl.sourceIcons; explicit members by allowed source
icons.stateSwitch: existing Compound visibility rules and images
icons.aiCreate: optional approved Lucide iconId on image layer; mapped to existing recolorable libraryIcon, stroke2; mutually exclusive with uploaded referenceId; static icon is not automatic data binding

nativeTint.scope: recolorable library icons at 6..128 physical pixels; grayscale glyphs preserve runtime ink and AOD ink
nativeTint.budget: 96 mask layers, aggregate 131072 physical glyph pixels, <=512x2048 atlas per layer
nativeTint.fallback: unmeasured target, full-colour or unsupported size uses existing bitmap path without new runtime-tint guarantee
nativeTint.calibration: SDK9.3 y-1 font inset; native recapture required

bitmapFonts.format: single-page Unicode BMFont text + 8-bit grayscale PNG
bitmapFonts.aod: same fixed pixel size, cannot silently resize
bitmapFonts.preview: shared advances, kerning, offsets, baseline, target pixel truncation
bitmapFonts.missing: visible box in preview; generation blocked before resource preparation
bitmapFonts.ai: public font operation selects approved IDs; no raw font upload to model
bitmapFonts.nativeCalibration: SDK 9.3: measured 1px top inset compensation; glyph overhang retained; upgrades require screenshot revalidation

typography.tabularDigits: 0-9 required; uniform advance, suppress kerning adjacent to digits
typography.nativeAdvancedVisual: SDK9.3 measured licensed 3-font/2-size active and 454 forced-AOD fixtures; integer metrics and vertical alignment match; dark AA differences remain; not Sleep/hardware

browserRasterization.input: authorized project TTF/OTF or licensed library fonts
browserRasterization.glyphSubset: all current layer source choices and 0-9 required; user additional BMP glyphs; missing rejects
browserRasterization.limits: existing bitmap font, atlas, project and target budgets apply

bitmapFonts.deviceOverrides: Schema48 permits per-device registered fonts, bitmap IDs and typography; null clears an inherited optional font field and is never a Layer value
bitmapFonts.nativeMetricStorage: one lazy metrics record, sorted numeric glyph-code and advance arrays, binary lookup; no startup dictionary for every theme/font; same layout API

libraryFonts.aiCreate: optional fontId selects only approved library IDs; converted to registered font fields; no arbitrary paths/bytes
libraryFonts.fontWeight: actual file outlines; no synthetic weight guarantee
libraryFonts.missing: required glyph coverage checked during local resource preparation; Chinese requires chalkHan in AI create
libraryFonts.legacyReleaseV2: frozen original four fonts and their hashes, not the current catalog

visualKits.resources: registered licensed fontId and lucide iconId; resolved before editing
visualKits.colorBindings: explicit layer IDs, editable project color controls; no guessed adjacency
visualKits.aod: independent activeVisible:false time layer; rendering not a Sleep/hardware acceptance
visualKits.ai: editable composition guidance, selected sources override defaults; no automatic guarantee of generated controls
visualKits.fontPreparation: browser-local grouped approved TTF to BMF, max8 font/physical-size groups; full license, atomic validation, matching independent AOD sizes

multiDeviceThemeUpgrade.scope: shared definition with existing installed target list retained
multiDeviceThemeUpgrade.overrides: new device defaults then compatible user overrides; explicit font identity retained atomically
multiDeviceThemeUpgrade.resources: referenced old local/bitmap fonts retained; conflicts, budgets or glyph/pixel incompatibility reject whole update
multiDeviceThemeUpgrade.history: undo restores shared design, variants, target, scope and resources; current code histories retained as stale
multiDeviceThemeUpgrade.nativeMigration: editor design update only; cross-PRG properties upgrade acceptance remains separate

appearanceRoles.fontRoles: max32 explicit theme/common families, approved font identities only; literal member fonts validated; change in editor then regenerate
appearanceRoles.individualFont: manual font change detaches only that member; move/size retains family link; device overrides independent
appearanceRoles.thresholds: warning/danger/primary map by explicit source meaning for heartRate and battery; unrelated sources have no old ranges; fixed threshold color bindings apply only original slot source
appearanceRoles.detach: materialize current color before removing only the explicit binding; fonts retain current outlines; locked members reject
appearanceRoles.legacy: old widget/release-v2 remains frozen; no new runtime font menu implied

componentStyles.scope: shared design only; one-level compound instances
componentStyles.appearance: explicit stable slot-key to private-layer-id mapping; geometry/color/AOD fields from compoundStyleKeys
componentStyles.preserved: parent bounds, data/source configuration, public part switches, independent compound and device overrides, origin notices
componentStyles.version: publish increments integer version atomically; locked instance blocks all; detach preserves current appearance, delete rejects linked definitions
componentStyles.ai: public root create/publish/detach only; no direct private map or definition updates
componentStyles.unsupported: font family, asset/structure replacement, nested instances and parent rotation are outside this style contract

themeFontBudget.policy: Counts are not memory certification; full compiled target, each theme/mode, SDK and native resources are verified separately. Original TTF bytes and complete licenses remain local.

evidence: Source parity and regression fixtures; SDK/device acceptance is recorded separately in docs/stage-validation.md.
